title: split-airgap-values-and-delegated-init-wave-controller
author: Marta Liu
description: Motivation: air-gapped/private installs have several implicit assumptions in the existing values.yaml templates: image pre-pull behavior, init job sequencing, and hook ownership are entangled with a single values tree which makes upgrades and rollbacks fragile when offline registries or signing/verification steps are required. This PR separates the airgap-specific value overlays from the core init sequencing templates and introduces a delegated init-wave controller that can be toggled per-tenant. Summary of changes: 1) Add values schema: chart/values-airgap.schema.json (new overlay set) and update values.schema.json with a top-level 'airgap' overlay pointer. 2) Factor templates: chart/templates/init-waves-delegated.yaml (new controller-backed wave template), chart/templates/init-waves-legacy.yaml (backward-compatible path), chart/templates/airgap-prepull-daemonset.yaml (optional, gated by airgap.prepull.enabled). 3) Helm helpers: chart/templates/_helpers-airgap.tpl for imagePullSecrets and signed-verify hooks. 4) Introduce hook annotations and signer tolerations to support on-prem signing daemons without altering the main RBAC. 5) Migration: a migration script is included under tooling/migrations/airgap-values-migrate.sh to translate old values.airgap.presets into the new shape with safe defaults. 6) Add unit and cluster-level tests: tests/helm/airgap-values-compat.test and e2e/upgrades/airgap-rollback.test. Compatibility: default behaviour is unchanged unless clusters opt-in with values.airgap.enabled=true or by setting delegatedInit.enabled=true. Migration notes: clusters using the old airgap.presets should run the migration script before upgrading the chart; automated migration will be run for Dedicated installs during staging rollout; for on-prem customers we recommend running the script in a maintenance window. Rollback safety: the delegated controller introduces a feature-flag and a legacy-path so charts can be rolled back safely if the controller is not yet available. Testing: ran helm lint, chart-verify, unit tests, and multi-tenant e2e on a local airgapped kind cluster with image mirroring. Related: references ENG-2731 for phased rollouts and SUP-8942 for a customer support thread about failed airgap post-upgrade hooks. Checklist: - [x] values schema and examples - [x] migration helper script - [x] helm tests and e2e - [x] docs: docs/airgap/README.md updated with migration steps - [x] addrelease notes entry
